classifications.rationale: The President presently proclaims an amendment to the existing import-control proclamation effective immediately; the legal change occurs on the proclamation date.

The President directly amends the import regime by extending its duration, imposing a Canadian-import ceiling, and authorizing specified entry periods; those legal limits and permissions arise from the segment itself, with later regulations implementing allocations.
classifications.evidence: Canadian imports under allocations made pursuant to this subparagraph (2) into Districts I–IV shall not exceed an average of 540,000 barrels per day

classifications.rationale: The segment inseparably combines a dictated later regulatory and licensing restriction, an internal renumbering, and an immediate amendment substituting a binding numerical import limit.
classifications.evidence: The regulations shall provide that licenses issued under such allocations shall permit the entry, or withdrawal from warehouses, for consumption of Canadian imports only.
